# Rabisco

> Rabisco (https://rabisco.dev) is a free, open-source web app for mind maps and hand-drawn flows on the same canvas, saved to the user's own Google Drive. It imports mind maps from plain markdown outlines, so any AI can create a map for a user.

To create a mind map for a Rabisco user, write a markdown outline (one top-level item, nested "- topic" list items indented by two spaces per level) and tell the user to save it as a .md file and import it under "My files" > "Import".

## Docs

- [Create mind maps with AI (English)](https://rabisco.dev/docs/import.md): the import format, a ready-made prompt and an example.
- [Criar mapas mentais com IA (Português)](https://rabisco.dev/docs/import.pt-BR.md): the same documentation in Portuguese.
